content: {"action":"write_off","reasoning":"The payer adjudicated CPT 93271 as bundled under CO-97, so it is not separately payable and the case provides no coding error or basis to overturn the bundling determination. Resubmission risks a duplicate denial, while authorization, records, medical-necessity appeal, and peer-to-peer review do not address bundling; the contractual balance also cannot be shifted to the patient."}
